# Render mode and lifecycle (AP-RND)

[Back to catalog](index.md)

## AP-RND-01

**Interactive component on a static page** — severity **major**, automated (tool), principles P-16.

**Why it hurts.** In a Blazor Web App, pages without an interactive render mode are static SSR: Radzen events (Click, Change, LoadData) never fire.

**Fix.** Apply the render mode used by the analogous feature (@rendermode or the global Routes render mode).

**Detection:** profile health RND-H01 + manual review of the changed page.

## AP-RND-02

**Data loaded twice because of prerendering** — severity **major**, manual review (G7), principles P-16, P-10.

**Why it hurts.** With prerendering, OnInitializedAsync runs on the server prerender and again when the component becomes interactive: two backend calls and a flicker.

**Fix.** Persist prerendered state (PersistentComponentState / [PersistentState]) or follow the repository approach; for LoadData grids, remember LoadData is not raised during prerender.

## AP-RND-03

**JavaScript interop during initialization** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-16.

**Why it hurts.** JS interop is not available during prerendering; calls in OnInitialized(Async) throw.

**Fix.** Move interop to OnAfterRenderAsync(firstRender).

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cs`; pattern `OnInitialized(Async)?\s*\(\s*\)\s*(\{[^}]*|=>[^;]*)\bJS(Runtime)?\.Invoke`.

## AP-RND-04

**async void method** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-12.

**Why it hurts.** Exceptions from async void are not observed by Blazor’s error handling and can crash the circuit; the renderer also cannot await the handler.

**Fix.** Return Task (Blazor awaits Task-returning event handlers).

**Bad:**

```razor
async void Delete() { await Api.DeleteAsync(id); }
```

**Good:**

```razor
async Task Delete() { await Api.DeleteAsync(id); }
```

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cs`; pattern `\basync\s+void\s+\w+\s*\(`.

## AP-RND-05

**Blocking on async code** — severity **major**, automated (scanner), principles P-12.

**Why it hurts.** .Result, .Wait() and GetAwaiter().GetResult() block the renderer thread and can deadlock (always on WebAssembly).

**Fix.** await the task.

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cs`; pattern `(Async\s*\([^()]*\)\s*\.Result\b|\.Wait\s*\(\s*\)|\.GetAwaiter\s*\(\s*\)\s*\.GetResult\s*\(\s*\))`.

## AP-RND-06

**StateHasChanged inside a loop** — severity **minor**, automated (scanner), principles P-10.

**Why it hurts.** Re-rendering per iteration is expensive and rarely needed.

**Fix.** Update state, then call StateHasChanged once (or rely on the automatic render after the handler).

**Detection:** files `*.razor`, `*.cs`; pattern `(foreach|for|while)\s*\([^)]*\)\s*\{[^{}]*StateHasChanged\s*\(`.

## AP-RND-07

**Missing @key on dynamic lists** — severity **minor**, manual review (G7), principles P-10.

**Why it hurts.** Without @key, re-ordered lists re-use component instances and state leaks between rows.

**Fix.** Add @key with a stable identifier in loops that render components.
